descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Strawberry Spring' Pink Reticulated Variegated Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 ‘Strawberry Spring’ leafs out in the spring with one of the prettiest spring pinks of any Japanese maple. The dark green veins etch through the pink reticulated leaves. As the leaves mature, the strawberry effect begins to fade to a creamy green, then to a green, with pink new growth again during the summer. In the fall, ‘Strawberry Spring’ puts on a display of oranges and reds. ‘Strawberry Spring’ is a relatively new introduction, but we expect it to reach 6-8 ft in height in 10 years in an upright manner. ‘Strawberry Spring’ was found and selected as a seedling from 'Amber Ghost’ by Talon Buchholz.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Strawberry Spring' 粉色网斑锦日本枫，适生分区 5-9。 'Strawberry Spring' 春季展叶时呈现日本枫中极为出色的春粉色之一，深绿色叶脉清晰勾勒在粉色网斑叶面上。 随着叶片成熟，这种“草莓色”效果会逐渐褪为奶油绿色，随后转为绿色，而夏季新梢又会再次抽生粉色新叶。 秋季时，'Strawberry Spring' 展现橙色与红色交织的秋叶表现。 该品种属于较新的引种，但预计以直立姿态生长，10 年可达 6-8 英尺高。 'Strawberry Spring' 由 Talon Buchholz 从 'Amber Ghost' 的实生苗中发现并选出。
